verdict.line: You lose if you let Teemo poke freely from range 1-6 with no answer; you win if you crash waves and force all-ins where Feint and Shadow Dash equalize his damage.

brief.thesis: This is a true even matchup at 50.7% Shen win rate over 897 games because Shen has no way to punish Teemo's range 680 Q (Blinding Dart) or E (Toxic Shot) poke, but Teemo has almost no answer to Shen's W (Feint) absorbing a trade or E (Shadow Dash) closing the gap to taunt him. Whoever controls wave state controls the lane: if Teemo can sit at max range and poke, he wins the damage race; if Shen forces short trades by crashing waves, Feint negates the alpha strike.

theirWindow.when: Dart is up and you're at range 680
theirWindow.what: He will land the blind before trading, which removes your ability to last-hit or react to Toxic Shot stacking. Back off to minion-range until Dart is on cooldown, then step up to farm.

yourWindow.when: Dart is down and wave is near his tower
yourWindow.what: Use E (Shadow Dash, 16/14/12/10/8s cooldown) to dash in and taunt him, forcing the trade at melee range where Q (Vorpal Blade) and your passive Ki Strike proc outvalue his autos. Pop W (Feint) just before he can land Toxic Shot stacks to absorb the burst.

start.why: Taken in 80% of games (48.8% win rate over 875) because it directly offsets Teemo's poke-based Toxic Shot and Blinding Dart chip damage through the sustain-on-hit effect.

boots.why: 69.9% pick rate at 49.8% win rate; the magic resist directly reduces both Toxic Shot's damage-over-time and Noxious Trap's poison cloud.

core.why: First item in the top three build paths; the health scaling and wave-clear let you crash lane and force the close-range trades Teemo wants to avoid.
Second item in both top paths (55% and 53.8% win rate); builds the health pool that makes Feint's absorption window matter more in extended trades.
Highest win rate completion at 55% over 40 games; punishes Teemo's attack-speed-reliant Toxic Shot poke pattern if he keeps auto-ing you.

situational.when: teemo is building into a full AP poke setup and you need the magic shield to survive his damage-over-time stacking
you want earlier wave-clear and sustain to crash lanes faster against his ranged harass
teemo is attacking you directly instead of poking from max range and you need the grievous wounds to cut his sustain

runes.keystoneWhy: Taken in the top rune page (40.4% pick, 48.8% win rate); the proc rewards you for staying in minion-range to farm through Teemo's poke rather than backing off, and the health scaling compounds versus his damage-over-time effects.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 60.6% of games at 48.9% win rate; Ignite punishes the all-in trades you force with Shadow Dash and denies Teemo's sustain from Toxic Shot stacking if he tries to disengage.

playing.title: Track Dart cooldown before stepping up
playing.detail: Blinding Dart has an 8s cooldown and 680 range. Only approach to last-hit or trade once you've seen it used, since the blind removes your vision and ability to react.

playing.title: Crash waves to force melee range
playing.detail: Push minions into his tower so he cannot stay at max range poking with Toxic Shot; this forces him to either trade in Vorpal Blade range or lose CS.

playing.title: Save Feint for the all-in, not chip damage
playing.detail: W (Feint) only lasts a few seconds and has a 9-5s cooldown depending on rank. Hold it for when he commits multiple autos or Dart, not for passive poke.

playing.title: Use Shadow Dash to close gaps, not just taunt minions
playing.detail: E (Shadow Dash) taunts every enemy champion it passes through on its 575-range path. Line it up through Teemo specifically when he's out of position to force the fight.

playing.title: Respect Noxious Trap zoning after level 11
playing.detail: Traps have a 1s cooldown and 230 range, letting Teemo lay multiple in your dash lane. Scout the ground before committing Shadow Dash into brush or jungle entrances.

playing.title: Play around jungler ganks, not solo kills
playing.detail: Solo-kill rate is even at 897 games sampled, meaning neither side reliably kills the other alone. Group with your jungler for kill pressure instead of forcing 1v1s.

playing.title: Hold Stand United for teamfight swings
playing.detail: R has a 200/180/160/160/160s cooldown and global range. Since lane itself is even, your biggest edge comes from teleporting into a side fight Teemo's team can't see coming.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning on cooldowns, timings, and trade patterns is my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Use Doran’s Shield and Second Wind to recover while using [W] and [P] to shield Teemo’s damage. Teemo is vulnerable to ganks, so kill him with your jungler.
